titleAr: المساعد بيرد على الصور والملفات والاستيكرز
titleEn: Agent answers pictures, files and stickers politely

ar: العميل بعت صورة والمساعد عمل إيه؟
en: What does the agent do when a customer sends a picture or a file?

steps: A picture, document, video, audio file or sticker gets one short note: say it in words or ask for a person (no model call, no credit, nothing read from the file; the media stays in the inbox)
At most one note per customer per 10 minutes; a payment screenshot at the InstaPay proof step still goes to the ordering bot
edgeCases: A voice note (Meta voice flag true or absent) is still transcribed
'عايز اكلم حد' after the note still hands over
gaps: The agent does not read pictures (no OCR, no visual search)
